name: plans_active_flag_per_plan
why: ACTIVE_YN becomes a boolean; no canonicalization rule compares 'Y' with true, so the flag is graded here.
source_sql: SELECT code AS "code", CASE WHEN active_yn = 'Y' THEN 'true' WHEN active_yn = 'N' THEN 'false' ELSE 'other' END AS "active" FROM plans

name: plans_tier_decode
why: TIER_CD is decoded through CODES PLAN_TIER; source integer vs target string.
source_sql: SELECT p.code AS "code", NVL(c.code_desc, 'UNKNOWN(' || TO_CHAR(p.tier_cd) || ')') AS "tier" FROM plans p LEFT JOIN codes c ON c.code_type = 'PLAN_TIER' AND c.code_val = p.tier_cd

name: tenants_tax_exempt_counts
why: TAX_EXEMPT_YN becomes a boolean; graded as a distribution over 69 tenants.
source_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN tax_exempt_yn = 'Y' THEN 'true' WHEN tax_exempt_yn = 'N' THEN 'false' ELSE 'other' END AS "taxExempt", COUNT(*) AS "n" FROM tenants GROUP BY CASE WHEN tax_exempt_yn = 'Y' THEN 'true' WHEN tax_exempt_yn = 'N' THEN 'false' ELSE 'other' END

name: tenants_status_decode_counts
why: STATUS_CD is decoded through CODES TENANT_STATUS.
source_sql: SELECT NVL(c.code_desc, 'UNKNOWN(' || TO_CHAR(t.status_cd) || ')') AS "status", COUNT(*) AS "n" FROM tenants t LEFT JOIN codes c ON c.code_type = 'TENANT_STATUS' AND c.code_val = t.status_cd GROUP BY NVL(c.code_desc, 'UNKNOWN(' || TO_CHAR(t.status_cd) || ')')

name: subscription_status_decode_counts
why: The embedded subscriptions carry a decoded SUB_STATUS; graded as a distribution over all 69 subscriptions.
source_sql: SELECT NVL(c.code_desc, 'UNKNOWN(' || TO_CHAR(s.status_cd) || ')') AS "status", COUNT(*) AS "n" FROM subscriptions s LEFT JOIN codes c ON c.code_type = 'SUB_STATUS' AND c.code_val = s.status_cd GROUP BY NVL(c.code_desc, 'UNKNOWN(' || TO_CHAR(s.status_cd) || ')')

name: codes_lookup_identity
why: The CODES table is the decode authority for every other unit, so its rows are compared whole.
source_sql: SELECT code_type AS "codeType", TO_CHAR(code_val) AS "codeVal", code_desc AS "codeDesc" FROM codes
